article.story: RADFORD, Va. -- — Gabriel Ferreira’s 17 points helped Radford defeat Shenandoah 102-63 on Saturday. Ferreira added eight rebounds and three steals for the Highlanders (1-3). Frederik Erichsen scored 15 points, finishing 6 of 8 from the floor. Mathieu Grujicic had 14 points and shot 4 of 6 from the field and 4 of 6 from the free-throw line. Ellis Wright finished with 16 points and two steals for the Hornets. Maxwell Lanham added 13 points and two steals for Shenandoah. Andrew Ford finished with 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
